t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The person tried numerous ways in. order to achieve the best result but ultimately they couldn't find one. They first tried off by looking at the colours of the gnomes and making their selection based on this but found that it wasn't giving them any more mushrooms. Then they tried to alternate between the 's' and 'k' keys when different multipliers came up but again, this didn't yield any different results for the participant. Ultimately, they don't believe that there are any specific ways in which they could maximise their mushrooms harvest.

vb_textbox.text: To be honest after the practices I wasn't sure if there was any technique whatsoever to maximise the mushrooms harvested. Therefore, from the first round onwards I just selected 'k' and then ended up on a good amount of points. In the first round I tried to go for colours, hat height/length but all of the figures were really similar so I genuinely did not think that there was any difference between any of the selections. I tried different selection with different multipliers too but this did not work for me either.
